style: Say firmly but kindly and cheerfully, like a friendly drum major giving clear directions to young kids
lines: Line up the band in pairs. Add musicians, and see if everyone gets a partner.
Now make rows. Pick how many rows, and how many in each row.
One musician, no partner yet. One is odd.
Everyone has a partner! Two is even: one plus one.
Three musicians make one pair, and one has no partner. Three is odd.
Everyone has a partner! Four is even: two plus two.
Five musicians make two pairs, and one has no partner. Five is odd.
Everyone has a partner! Six is even: three plus three.
Seven musicians make three pairs, and one has no partner. Seven is odd.
Everyone has a partner! Eight is even: four plus four.
Nine musicians make four pairs, and one has no partner. Nine is odd.
Everyone has a partner! Ten is even: five plus five.
Eleven musicians make five pairs, and one has no partner. Eleven is odd.
Everyone has a partner! Twelve is even: six plus six.
Thirteen musicians make six pairs, and one has no partner. Thirteen is odd.
Everyone has a partner! Fourteen is even: seven plus seven.
Fifteen musicians make seven pairs, and one has no partner. Fifteen is odd.
Everyone has a partner! Sixteen is even: eight plus eight.
Seventeen musicians make eight pairs, and one has no partner. Seventeen is odd.
Everyone has a partner! Eighteen is even: nine plus nine.
Nineteen musicians make nine pairs, and one has no partner. Nineteen is odd.
Everyone has a partner! Twenty is even: ten plus ten.
One row of one makes one. One is odd.
One row of two makes two. Two is even.
One row of three makes three. Three is odd.
One row of four makes four. Four is even.
One row of five makes five. Five is odd.
Two rows of one make two. Two is even.
Two rows of two make four. Four is even.
Two rows of three make six. Six is even.
Two rows of four make eight. Eight is even.
Two rows of five make ten. Ten is even.
Three rows of one make three. Three is odd.
Three rows of two make six. Six is even.
Three rows of three make nine. Nine is odd.
Three rows of four make twelve. Twelve is even.
Three rows of five make fifteen. Fifteen is odd.
Four rows of one make four. Four is even.
Four rows of two make eight. Eight is even.
Four rows of three make twelve. Twelve is even.
Four rows of four make sixteen. Sixteen is even.
Four rows of five make twenty. Twenty is even.
Five rows of one make five. Five is odd.
Five rows of two make ten. Ten is even.
Five rows of three make fifteen. Fifteen is odd.
Five rows of four make twenty. Twenty is even.
Five rows of five make twenty-five. Twenty-five is odd.
